judgment.notes: Extended diameter is the supremum of extended pairwise distances, with empty diameter zero. Its real-valued interpretation is restricted to bounded Euclidean sets; no boundedness or existence assumption is introduced.

The countable-cover infimum and positive-scale supremum specify unnormalized H with values in [0,infinity], positive exponent/scale, diameter bound ≤delta, and zero empty-member cost. These match problem.md:34-47. The stated usual-dimension interpretation is justified through the exported bridge N001, not an extra premise granted by this definition.

The designation μH[a]=Measure.hausdorffMeasure a agrees with the pinned definition mkMetric(r↦r^a), including arbitrary-subset outer-measure evaluation and zero empty-set cost. Borel structure, real exponent and extended powers are explicit. Read Hausdorff.lean:410-440,464-469,535-552; the countable-cover formula remains M001.

The supremum over nonnegative finite exponents with μH[a](A)=infinity agrees with native dimH and its Borelized definition (HausdorffDimension.lean:94-112). Codomain and empty supremum are explicit; exponent zero adds only zero to dimension. Positive-exponent equivalence with the supplied H is exported by N001, preserving the problem's normalization.
